title: Neon Lanes
objective: Drive as far as possible down a synthwave highway, dodging pink X blocks and jumping over orange barriers while collecting coins.
controls: Swipe left or right to switch between the 3 lanes; swipe up to jump over barriers.
core_loop: Swipe to switch lanes or jump -> avoid obstacles and collect coins -> increase speed and distance.
progression: Speed steadily escalates from SPD 51 to SPD 85 as distance increases, accompanied by tighter obstacle and barrier patterns.
hook_idea: High-speed dodging through tight pink X block formations and jumping consecutive orange barriers at SPD 81-85 (t=19.5-23.8s).
